# Jim van Duijsen

> Freelance developer and entrepreneur based in the Netherlands, building AI agents, automation workflows, and websites for businesses.

Jim van Duijsen is a developer based in the Netherlands. He founded Havonyx (a done-for-you agency that builds custom AI agents and automation systems for businesses) and Jimvd Web Agency (a web agency delivering modern websites and web apps). He also takes on freelance development work for clients directly, including Crypto Insiders.

- [About](https://www.jimvanduijsen.com/about): Projects, background, and freelance work
- [Contact](https://www.jimvanduijsen.com/contact): Get in touch

## Projects

- [Havonyx](https://havonyx.com/): Custom AI agent systems for businesses — practical automation built around real workflows
- [Jimvd Web Agency](https://jimvd.xyz): Full-service web agency offering design, development, SEO, hosting, and maintenance using Next.js and Vercel
